translations.web: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
translations.bsb: He has filled the hungry with good things, but has sent the rich away empty.
translations.kjv: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
translations.asv: The hungry he hath filled with good things; And the rich he hath sent empty away.
